mapper.select: select s.shift_id, s.store_id, s.shift_date, s.shift_code, s.shift_name, s.user_id, s.user_name, s.nick_name, s.open_amount, s.close_amount, s.order_count, s.total_amount, s.settle_id, s.status, s.open_time, s.close_time, s.create_time, s.update_time from biz_cashier_shift s where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.shift_date = #{shiftDate} and s.shift_code = #{shiftCode} limit 1

select s.shift_id, s.store_id, s.shift_date, s.shift_code, s.shift_name, s.user_id, s.user_name, s.nick_name, s.open_amount, s.close_amount, s.order_count, s.total_amount, s.settle_id, s.status, s.open_time, s.close_time, s.create_time, s.update_time from biz_cashier_shift s where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.status = 1 order by s.shift_id desc

select count(distinct o.order_id) as order_count, ifnull(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as total_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 1 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as cash_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 2 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as wechat_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 3 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as alipay_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 4 then p.pay_amount - ifnull(p.refund_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as stored_amount, ifnull(sum(case when p.pay_method = 5 then p.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as campus_amount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(p.refund_amount, 0)), 0) as refund_amount, ifnull(sum(o.point_amount), 0) as point_amount from biz_order o left join biz_payment p on p.order_id = o.order_id where o.status <> 5 and o.create_time >= #{begin} and o.create_time <= #{end}
